The query has 55 windows. Let me look at the features:
- variance_log_ratio: mean 0.0327, trend -0.01 (slightly decreasing)
- ac1: mean 0.6389, trend 0.0781 (increasing autocorrelation - classic early warning signal)
- skewness: mean -0.0491, trend 0.2398 (increasing skewness)
- kurtosis: mean -0.2442, trend -0.4845 (decreasing kurtosis)
- trend_slope: mean 0.1635, trend 0.3719 (increasing trend slope)
- tau_variance: mean 0.0163, trend -0.0085
- tau_ac1: mean 0.0112, trend 0.0954
- low_freq_power: mean 0.6069, trend 0.0614 (increasing low frequency power)

The trends show increasing autocorrelation (ac1), increasing skewness, increasing trend slope, increasing low frequency power - these are classic early warning signals of approaching a tipping point. Decreasing kurtosis and variance_log_ratio are also consistent with critical slowing down in some systems.
